purpose: Evaluate deep-read recall, exclude/defer precision, EvidenceSchema alignment, scientific reasons, and boundary handling before/after prompt changes.

prompt.user_query: Which electrolyte design most directly improves Li-metal Coulombic efficiency at high current density, and what failure mechanism limits it?

candidates.title: Localized high-concentration electrolyte enables stable lithium metal cycling at 5 mA cm-2
candidates.abstract: Reports Coulombic efficiency at 5 mA cm-2 and attributes failure at higher current to transport-limited interfacial depletion.

candidates.title: A broad review of rechargeable battery electrolytes
candidates.abstract: Surveys electrolyte families across lithium-ion, sodium-ion, and lithium-metal batteries without focused high-current measurements.

candidates.title: Thermal conductivity of graphite current collectors
candidates.abstract: Measures in-plane thermal conductivity of graphite sheets for heat spreading.

oracle.rationale: M1 directly addresses both decision-critical targets; M2 is broad background; M3 is scientifically unrelated.

prompt.user_query: Do retrieval-augmented memory systems improve long-horizon tool-using agents, compared with no persistent memory?

candidates.title: Persistent retrieval memory for long-horizon tool agents
candidates.abstract: Compares identical agents with and without retrieval memory on 30-step tool tasks and reports task success and recovery metrics.

candidates.title: A taxonomy of language-model agents
candidates.abstract: Categorizes planning, memory, tool use, and multi-agent architectures across prior work.

candidates.title: Vector database indexing throughput
candidates.abstract: Benchmarks ANN index build speed and query latency without agent evaluation.

oracle.rationale: C1 is the direct controlled comparison; C2 is contextual background; C3 does not test the research question.

prompt.user_query: What electronic-structure mechanism explains Sc-induced softening of wurtzite AlScN?

candidates.title: First-principles origin of elastic softening in wurtzite Al1-xScxN
candidates.abstract: Density-functional calculations link softening to composition-driven changes in bonding and energy landscape along internal structural distortions.

candidates.title: Sputter deposition rate of AlScN films
candidates.abstract: Maps growth rate versus power and pressure but does not analyze electronic structure or elastic origin.

candidates.title: Piezoelectric nitrides: a review
candidates.abstract: Reviews AlN-family piezoelectrics and summarizes reported Sc-alloy trends and device applications.

oracle.rationale: T1 directly provides the requested mechanism; T2 is process data without mechanism; T3 is broader background.

prompt.user_query: Compare ALD and sputtering for conformal TiN on high-aspect-ratio structures; which route preserves conductivity while improving coverage?

candidates.title: Direct comparison of ALD and reactive sputtered TiN in 20:1 trenches
candidates.abstract: Measures step coverage and resistivity for both processes on the same trench geometry and discusses the trade-off between coverage and conductivity.

candidates.title: Low-resistivity sputtered TiN on planar silicon
candidates.abstract: Optimizes sputter power for planar-film resistivity; no high-aspect-ratio coverage measurement or ALD comparison.

candidates.title: ALD TiN nucleation chemistry
candidates.abstract: Studies precursor reactions and early-cycle nucleation on oxide surfaces; does not report trench coverage or electrical comparison.

oracle.rationale: H1 is uniquely decision-complete because it compares both routes under the same geometry and measures both targets.

prompt.user_query: Why does adding a small amount of oxygen suppress dendrites in zinc anodes?

candidates.title: Operando imaging reveals oxygen-mediated zinc nucleation
candidates.abstract: Operando microscopy and interfacial spectroscopy show oxygen changes nucleation density and local electric-field distribution during zinc deposition.

candidates.title: Long-life zinc cycling with oxygen additive
candidates.abstract: Reports 500-cycle lifetime improvement with oxygen additive but does not resolve the interfacial mechanism.

candidates.title: Zinc-air cathode catalyst durability
candidates.abstract: Studies oxygen reduction catalysts in zinc-air cathodes, not zinc metal deposition.

oracle.rationale: G1 provides mechanism-resolving evidence; G2 supports the phenomenon but not the requested causal explanation; G3 is a domain-near mismatch.

prompt.user_query: Does Mo substrate texture influence c-axis orientation of sputtered AlScN?

evidence_targets.question: Mo texture effect on AlScN orientation

candidates.title: Effect of molybdenum substrate texture on c-axis orientation of sputtered AlScN
Residual stress in Mo electrodes
candidates.abstract: Measures Mo stress as a function of argon pressure without depositing AlScN.

candidates.title: AlScN acoustic resonators
candidates.abstract: Reports resonator performance and stack design; substrate texture is not analyzed.

oracle.rationale: A1 has an exact title-level match but missing abstract; it must not be treated as irrelevant, and any positive ranking must state that evidence is title-level only.

prompt.user_query: How does Sc content change piezoelectric coefficient d33 in wurtzite AlScN thin films?

candidates.title: Sc-doped AlN for enhanced piezoelectric response
candidates.abstract: This work uses Sc-doped AlN only as a seed layer for GaN transistor fabrication and reports transistor mobility; no piezoelectric coefficient or composition series is measured.

candidates.title: Composition dependence of piezoelectric response in Al1-xScxN
candidates.abstract: Measures d33 across x=0.05-0.35 in sputtered wurtzite films and discusses the composition trend.

candidates.title: Scandium nitride transport properties
candidates.abstract: Reports carrier transport in rocksalt ScN.

oracle.rationale: The abstract must override a superficially relevant title when it clearly shows the paper does not address the target property.

prompt.user_query: Which interfacial reaction causes capacity fade in sulfide solid-state batteries at high voltage?

evidence_targets.question: specific high-voltage interfacial reaction causing fade

candidates.title: Operando XPS identifies high-voltage decomposition at NCM-sulfide interfaces
candidates.abstract: Tracks interfacial species during charging and links a specific oxidative decomposition pathway to impedance rise and capacity loss.

candidates.title: Interfaces in sulfide solid-state batteries: a review
candidates.abstract: Reviews cathode, anode, and electrolyte interfaces, summarizing common degradation mechanisms across many chemistries.

candidates.title: Mechanical stack pressure in solid-state cells
candidates.abstract: Studies pressure effects on contact loss without chemical characterization of the cathode interface.

oracle.rationale: The primary operando study should outrank broad review material for a specific mechanism question.

prompt.user_query: Does adding 1-2% fluorine reliably improve Li-metal cycling stability?

evidence_targets.question: effect of 1-2% fluorine on cycling stability

candidates.title: Fluorine additive improves lithium cycling in ether electrolyte
candidates.abstract: Reports improved Coulombic efficiency at 1% fluorine under 0.5 mA cm-2.

candidates.title: Fluorine additive shows no benefit at practical current density
candidates.abstract: At 2-4 mA cm-2, 1-2% fluorine produces no statistically significant lifetime gain and accelerates impedance growth under lean electrolyte.

candidates.title: Fluorinated polymer separators
candidates.abstract: Studies separator tensile strength and wetting; no fluorine additive is used in the electrolyte.

oracle.rationale: Decision-changing negative evidence is must-read even when it contradicts the apparent consensus; N1 remains relevant supportive positive evidence.

prompt.user_query: Which papers best explain why retrieval can hurt small language models on noisy corpora?

candidates.title: When retrieval hurts: distractor sensitivity in small language models
candidates.abstract: Evaluates small models with controlled distractor passages and analyzes attention shifts associated with accuracy drops.

candidates.title: Scaling laws for dense retrievers
candidates.abstract: Measures retriever recall as encoder size increases; downstream small-LM robustness is not studied.

oracle.rationale: Screening must work normally without EvidenceSchema and must not invent target IDs.

prompt.user_query: How do Mo roughness and substrate temperature affect AlScN texture and residual stress?

candidates.title: Molybdenum roughness controls AlScN texture
candidates.abstract: Quantifies Mo roughness and AlScN rocking-curve width at fixed temperature.

candidates.title: Substrate temperature and residual stress in AlScN
candidates.abstract: Measures residual stress from 100-400 C at fixed Mo surface condition; texture is not reported.

candidates.title: AlScN etch selectivity
candidates.abstract: Compares chlorine plasma etch chemistries and selectivity to Mo.

oracle.rationale: P2 is core to the user question even though EvidenceSchema currently covers only texture; it must not be forced onto T_texture or demoted because the schema is partial.

prompt.user_query: What directly measured evidence links grain-boundary segregation to embrittlement in a Ni superalloy?

evidence_targets.question: direct measurement linking segregation and embrittlement

candidates.title: Atom-probe and fracture correlation of B segregation in Ni superalloy
candidates.abstract: Correlates atom-probe grain-boundary composition with fracture mode across heat treatments.

candidates.title: Open dataset of nickel alloy tensile curves
candidates.abstract: Provides tensile curves for several alloys but no grain-boundary chemistry measurements.
